data.name: TitleFitting
data.comment: Title of the fitting tool's own window, once it is detached from the main window. The tool's name, as in the navigation menu.

data.name: ItemsHeading
data.comment: Fitting tool: heading of the item list on the left, from which modules, charges, drones and the rest are added to a fit. Other texts point to the list by this name ("Add modules from Items").

data.name: FinderUnlistedGroup
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the group, at the end of the tree of market groups, holding items the market does not list.

data.name: FinderDragHint
data.value: Double-click an item to add it, or drag it onto a slot.
data.comment: Fitting tool, under the item list: how to put an item on the fit. A slot is a place on the ship a module goes, on the ring or in the list below it.

data.name: FilterAll
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the category pick list — every kind of item. Short.

data.name: FilterModules
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the category pick list — modules. Short.

data.name: FilterRigs
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the category pick list — rigs. Short.

data.name: FilterSubsystems
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the category pick list — subsystems (Tech III ships). Short.

data.name: FilterCharges
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the category pick list — charges (ammunition, scripts, anything a module loads). Short.

data.name: FilterDrones
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the category pick list — drones and fighters. Short.

data.name: FilterImplants
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the category pick list — implants. Short.

data.name: FilterBoosters
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the category pick list — boosters (the drugs a pilot takes). Short.

data.name: FilterOtherItems
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: the category pick list — anything else, which a fit can only carry in its cargo hold. Short.

data.name: SearchWatermark
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: hint in the empty search box. The search matches an item's name and its group's.

data.name: FitsOnly
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: check box — list only the modules, rigs and subsystems the open fit's hull can take.

data.name: TipShowEverySlot
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: tooltip on the ✕ beside a note such as "High slot modules only" — takes the note away and lists modules for every slot again.

data.name: AddToFit
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: button under the list — puts the selected item on the fit. Short.

data.name: AddToCargo
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: button under the list — puts the selected item in the fit's cargo hold. Short.

data.name: TipAddToCargo
data.value: Put the selected item in the cargo hold — anything can be carried
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: tooltip on the Add to cargo button.

data.name: FinderHigh
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: small label beside a module — the slot it goes in: a high slot. Very short.

data.name: FinderMid
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: small label beside a module — the slot it goes in: a mid slot. Very short.

data.name: FinderLow
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: small label beside a module — the slot it goes in: a low slot. Very short.

data.name: FinderService
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: small label beside a module — the slot it goes in: a structure's service slot. Very short.

data.name: FinderRig
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: small label beside an item — it is a rig. Very short.

data.name: FinderSubsystem
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: small label beside an item — it is a subsystem (Tech III ships). Very short.

data.name: FinderCharge
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: small label beside an item — it is a charge (ammunition, a script: something a module loads). Very short.

data.name: FinderDrone
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: small label beside an item — it is a drone. Very short.

data.name: FinderFighter
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: small label beside an item — it is a fighter. Very short.

data.name: KindImplant
data.comment: Fitting tool: small label beside an item — it is an implant. In the item list, and in the fit's list of implants and boosters. Very short.

data.name: KindBooster
data.comment: Fitting tool: small label beside an item — it is a booster (a drug a pilot takes). In the item list, and in the fit's list of implants and boosters. Very short.

data.name: FinderOnlyHigh
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: note above the list after an empty high slot was clicked on the ring — the list shows only modules for that slot.

data.name: FinderOnlyMid
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: note above the list after an empty mid slot was clicked on the ring — the list shows only modules for that slot.

data.name: FinderOnlyLow
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: note above the list after an empty low slot was clicked on the ring — the list shows only modules for that slot.

data.name: FinderOnlyRig
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: note above the list after an empty rig slot was clicked on the ring — the list shows only modules for that slot.

data.name: FinderOnlySubsystem
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: note above the list after an empty subsystem slot was clicked on the ring — the list shows only modules for that slot (Tech III ships).

data.name: FinderOnlyService
data.comment: Fitting tool, item list: note above the list after an empty service slot was clicked on the ring — the list shows only modules for that slot (a structure's service slot).

data.name: ToggleItems
data.comment: Fitting tool, top bar: button that shows or hides the item list. Keep the ☰ sign; the word is the list's heading (ItemsHeading).

data.name: TipToggleItems
data.value: Show or hide the item list
data.comment: Fitting tool, top bar: tooltip on the ☰ Items button.

data.name: NewFitLabel
data.comment: Fitting tool, top bar: label before the ways to start a fit — the hull box, Paste EFT…, From the game… and the saved fits. Upper case in English.

data.name: HullWatermark
data.value: Hull — type a name or class…
data.comment: Fitting tool, top bar: hint in the empty box where a hull (a ship type) is picked to start a new fit. The box matches a ship's name and its class (Frigate, Cruiser…).

data.name: PasteEft
data.comment: Fitting tool, top bar: button — import a fit pasted as EFT text. EFT is the name of the fitting text format the game and fitting sites use: keep it. Short.

data.name: OpenFit
data.comment: Fitting tool, new-fit bar: opens the picker of saved fits — EVE Console's own and the game's.

data.name: TipOpenFit
data.value: Open a fit saved in EVE Console, or one of your characters' fittings in the game
data.comment: Fitting tool, new-fit bar: tooltip on Open fit.

data.name: TitleOpenFit
data.comment: Fitting tool: title of the window listing saved fits to open.

data.name: FitSearchWatermark
data.value: Search by fit or hull name…
data.comment: Fitting tool, Open Fit window: placeholder in the search box above the list of fits.

data.name: NoFitsMatch
data.comment: Fitting tool, Open Fit window: status when the search leaves nothing in the list.

data.name: TitleDeleteSaved
data.comment: Fitting tool, Open Fit window: title of the yes/no question before deleting a fit saved in EVE Console.

data.name: ConfirmDeleteSaved
data.value: Delete the fit "{0}" saved in EVE Console? This cannot be undone.
data.comment: Fitting tool, Open Fit window: asked before deleting a fit saved in the app. {0} is the fit's name.

data.name: DeleteSaved
data.comment: Fitting tool, top bar: button — deletes the saved fit chosen in the list beside it. A verb.

data.name: TipDeleteSaved
data.value: Delete the fit chosen — only fits saved in EVE Console
data.comment: Fitting tool, Open Fit window: tooltip on Delete. Fittings in the game are not deleted from here.

data.name: EmptyToolHint
data.value: Start a fit from a hull, paste one, or open one from the game or your saved fits. Each opens in its own tab.
data.comment: Fitting tool: shown in the middle while no fit is open.

data.name: DropSideBySide
data.value: Drop here to see two fits side by side
data.comment: Fitting tool: shown over the right half while a fit's tab is dragged — dropping it there shows two fits at once.

data.name: TabNewFit
data.comment: Fitting tool: the title of a fit's tab while the fit has neither a name nor a hull.

data.name: TipTab
data.value: Drag to reorder, or onto the right half to see two fits side by side
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on a fit's tab.

data.name: TipTabDirty
data.value: Changed since it was opened or saved
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the dot on a fit's tab.

data.name: TipCloseFit
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the ✕ on a fit's tab.

data.name: PilotLabel
data.comment: Fitting tool, above a fit: label before the pilot pick list — whose skills the numbers are worked out with. Upper case in English.

data.name: TipPilot
data.value: Whose skills the numbers are calculated with
data.comment: Fitting tool, above a fit: tooltip on the pilot pick list.

data.name: PilotAllV
data.comment: Fitting tool, pilot pick list: a pilot with every skill at level V (the game writes skill levels in Roman numerals). Short.

data.name: PilotAll0
data.comment: Fitting tool, pilot pick list: a pilot with no skill trained (every skill at level 0). Short.

data.name: FitNameWatermark
data.comment: Fitting tool, above a fit: hint in the empty box holding the fit's name.

data.name: NewFitName
data.comment: Fitting tool: the name a new fit starts with, which the user can change. {0} is the hull's name (a ship type).

data.name: DefaultFitName
data.comment: Fitting tool: the name offered when a fit with no name is saved. {0} is the hull's name (a ship type).

data.name: GameFitDescription
data.comment: Written into the game as the description of a fitting saved from the fitting tool; the player reads it in the game client's fitting window. Keep "EVE Console" (the app's name) as it is.

data.name: GameFitNoName
data.comment: Written into the game as the name of a fitting saved with no name of its own (rare: a name is normally offered first). One short word.

data.name: CopyEft
data.comment: Fitting tool, above a fit: button — copies the fit to the clipboard as EFT text. EFT is the name of the fitting text format: keep it. Short.

data.name: TipCopyEft
data.value: Copy this fit to the clipboard as EFT text
data.comment: Fitting tool, above a fit: tooltip on the Copy EFT button.

data.name: SaveFit
data.comment: Fitting tool, beside the fit's name: saves the fit back where it was opened from or last saved (EVE Console, or a character's fittings in the game), without asking anything.

data.name: TipSaveFit
data.value: Save over the fit this was opened from or last saved as, without asking. For a fit never saved, use Save As.
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on Save. Save As is the button beside it.

data.name: SaveFitAs
data.comment: Fitting tool, beside Save: opens a dialog to choose a name and where to save the fit.

data.name: TipSaveFitAs
data.value: Choose a name and where to save: EVE Console, or a character's fittings in the game
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on Save As.

data.name: SavedInConsole
data.comment: Fitting tool, under the fit's name: where Save writes — this fit is one saved in the app itself.

data.name: SavedInGame
data.value: Saved in {0}'s fittings in the game
data.comment: Fitting tool, under the fit's name: where Save writes — a character's saved fittings in the game. {0} is the character's name.

data.name: NotSavedYet
data.comment: Fitting tool, under the fit's name: the fit has never been saved, so Save is off until Save As is used.

data.name: TitleOverwriteFit
data.comment: Fitting tool: title of the yes/no question asked before Save As overwrites a fit.

data.name: ConfirmOverwriteApp
data.value: A fit named "{0}" for this hull is already saved in EVE Console. Overwrite it?
data.comment: Fitting tool, Save As: asked before overwriting a fit of the same name and hull saved in the app. {0} is the fit's name.

data.name: ConfirmOverwriteGame
data.value: Replace the fitting "{0}" in {1}'s fittings in the game? The game cannot change a fitting, so the new one is saved first and the old one then deleted.
data.comment: Fitting tool, Save As: asked before replacing a character's fitting in the game. {0} is the fitting's name, {1} the character's.

data.name: GameSource
data.comment: Fitting tool, under a fit opened from the game: where it came from. {0} is the character's name, {1} the fitting's name.

data.name: SlotGroupHigh
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: heading of the high slots. {0} is how many are fitted, {1} how many the hull has. Two spaces before the numbers in English.

data.name: SlotGroupMid
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: heading of the mid slots. {0} is how many are fitted, {1} how many the hull has. Two spaces before the numbers in English.

data.name: SlotGroupLow
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: heading of the low slots. {0} is how many are fitted, {1} how many the hull has. Two spaces before the numbers in English.

data.name: SlotGroupRig
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: heading of the rig slots. {0} is how many are fitted, {1} how many the hull has. Two spaces before the numbers in English.

data.name: SlotGroupSubsystem
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: heading of the subsystem slots (Tech III ships). {0} is how many are fitted, {1} how many the hull has. Two spaces before the numbers in English.

data.name: SlotGroupService
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: heading of the service slots (a structure's service slot). {0} is how many are fitted, {1} how many the hull has. Two spaces before the numbers in English.

data.name: EmptyRowHigh
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: a free high slot. In square brackets, the way fitting texts mark a free slot.

data.name: EmptyRowMid
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: a free mid slot. In square brackets, the way fitting texts mark a free slot.

data.name: EmptyRowLow
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: a free low slot. In square brackets, the way fitting texts mark a free slot.

data.name: EmptyRowRig
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: a free rig slot. In square brackets, the way fitting texts mark a free slot.

data.name: EmptyRowSubsystem
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: a free subsystem slot (Tech III ships). In square brackets, the way fitting texts mark a free slot.

data.name: EmptyRowService
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: a free service slot (a structure's service slot). In square brackets, the way fitting texts mark a free slot.

data.name: StateOff
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: the button showing a module's state, clicked to change it — offline. Very short (about four letters fit); upper case in English.

data.name: StateOn
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: the button showing a module's state, clicked to change it — online (fitted and powered, not running). Very short (about four letters fit); upper case in English.

data.name: StateAct
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: the button showing a module's state, clicked to change it — active (running). Short for ACTIVE. Very short (about four letters fit); upper case in English.

data.name: StateHeat
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: the button showing a module's state, clicked to change it — overheated. Very short (about four letters fit); upper case in English.

data.name: TipStateOffline
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: tooltip on the state button of a module that is offline.

data.name: TipStateOnlineActivate
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: tooltip on the state button of a module that is online and can be activated.

data.name: TipStateOnlineOffline
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: tooltip on the state button of a module that is online and cannot be activated (a plate, a heat sink…).

data.name: TipStateActive
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: tooltip on the state button of a module that is active.

data.name: TipStateOverheated
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: tooltip on the state button of a module that is overheated.

data.name: HeatButton
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: the overheat switch beside a module's state button. Very short (about four letters fit, in a smaller type than the state button); upper case in English.

data.name: TipHeatStop
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: tooltip on the overheat switch while the module is overheated.

data.name: TipHeatStart
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: tooltip on the overheat switch while the module is not overheated.

data.name: NoCharge
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: the charge pick list of a module with nothing loaded.

data.name: TipModuleValue
data.comment: Fitting tool, module list: tooltip on a module's value.

data.name: Remove
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the ✕ of a module, drone, cargo or implant row, and the last item of a module's right-click menu on the ring — takes it off the fit. A verb.

data.name: TipChooseModule
data.value: Click to choose a module for this slot
data.comment: Fitting tool, the ring of slots around the ship: tooltip on an empty slot. Clicking it lists modules for that slot.

data.name: StateNameOffline
data.comment: Fitting tool, the ring of slots: a module's state, in the tooltip on its slot.

data.name: StateNameOnline
data.comment: Fitting tool, the ring of slots: a module's state, in the tooltip on its slot.

data.name: StateNameActive
data.comment: Fitting tool, the ring of slots: a module's state, in the tooltip on its slot.

data.name: StateNameOverheated
data.comment: Fitting tool, the ring of slots: a module's state, in the tooltip on its slot.

data.name: MenuPutOnline
data.comment: Fitting tool: item of a module's right-click menu on the ring.

data.name: MenuPutOffline
data.comment: Fitting tool: item of a module's right-click menu on the ring.

data.name: MenuActivate
data.comment: Fitting tool: item of a module's right-click menu on the ring. A verb.

data.name: MenuDeactivate
data.comment: Fitting tool: item of a module's right-click menu on the ring. A verb.

data.name: MenuOverheat
data.comment: Fitting tool: item of a module's right-click menu on the ring. A verb.

data.name: MenuStopOverheating
data.comment: Fitting tool: item of a module's right-click menu on the ring.

data.name: MenuUnload
data.comment: Fitting tool: item of a module's right-click menu on the ring — takes its charge out. {0} is the charge's name.

data.name: DronesHeading
data.comment: Fitting tool: heading of the fit's drones and fighter squadrons. Upper case in English.

data.name: InBay
data.comment: Fitting tool, a drone row: label before the number of drones in the drone bay. Short, lower case in English.

data.name: Launched
data.comment: Fitting tool, a drone row: label before the number of those drones launched (out in space). Short, lower case in English.

data.name: InTube
data.comment: Fitting tool, a fighter squadron row: check box — the squadron sits in a launch tube. Short, lower case in English.

data.name: TipInTube
data.value: Launched — squadrons in tubes are the ones counted in the fit's damage
data.comment: Fitting tool, a fighter squadron row: tooltip on the in tube check box.

data.name: TipStackValue
data.value: Market value of the whole stack
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the value of a drone stack or a cargo stack.

data.name: ClassLight
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter squadron's class — light fighters. Shown beside a squadron. Short.

data.name: ClassSupport
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter squadron's class — support fighters. Shown beside a squadron. Short.

data.name: ClassHeavy
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter squadron's class — heavy fighters. Shown beside a squadron. Short.

data.name: TipSquadronLight
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the size of a light fighter squadron. {0} is the most fighters it can hold.

data.name: TipSquadronSupport
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the size of a support fighter squadron. {0} is the most fighters it can hold.

data.name: TipSquadronHeavy
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the size of a heavy fighter squadron. {0} is the most fighters it can hold.

data.name: TipSquadron
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the size of a fighter squadron whose class is not known. {0} is the most fighters it can hold.

data.name: AbilityAttack
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (its standing attack), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityMissiles
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (its secondary missiles), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityBomb
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (a heavy bomber's bomb), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityKamikaze
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (a strike that spends the squadron), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityEnergyNeutralizer
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (drains a target's capacitor), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityStasisWebifier
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (slows a target), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityWarpDisruptor
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (stops a target warping), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityEcm
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (jams a target's sensors), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityTackle
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (holds a target), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityEvasiveManeuvers
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (a speed burst), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityAfterburner
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (a speed boost), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityMicrowarpdrive
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (a large speed boost), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: AbilityMicroJumpDrive
data.comment: Fitting tool: a fighter ability (a short jump), on its on/off switch under a squadron and before its damage. Use the game client's word where it has one. Short.

data.name: TipAbilityCounted
data.value: {0}: counted in the DPS while on
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the switch of a fighter ability that does damage. {0} is the ability's name. DPS is damage per second.

data.name: TipAbilityNoEffect
data.value: {0}: no effect on the fit's numbers
data.comment: Fitting tool: tooltip on the switch of a fighter ability that does no damage. {0} is the ability's name.

data.name: CargoHeading
data.comment: Fitting tool: heading of the fit's cargo. Upper case in English.

data.name: Quantity
data.comment: Fitting tool, a cargo row: label before the number of items. Short, lower case in English.

data.name: ImplantsHeading
data.comment: Fitting tool: heading of the pilot's implants and boosters. Upper case in English.

data.name: ResourcesHeading
data.comment: Fitting tool, the figures on the right: heading of the ship's fitting resources. Upper case in English.

data.name: Cpu
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures: the ship's CPU, which fitted modules use up. The game client's word.

data.name: Powergrid
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures: the ship's powergrid, which fitted modules use up. The game client's word.

data.name: Calibration
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures: the ship's calibration, which rigs use up. The game client's word.

data.name: Hardpoints
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures: {0} turrets fitted of {1} turret hardpoints; {2} launchers fitted of {3} launcher hardpoints. Four spaces separate the parts in English.

data.name: CargoLine
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures: {0} the volume the cargo takes up, {1} the cargo hold's capacity, in cubic metres.

data.name: CargoLineNoLimit
data.comment: Fitting tool, RESOURCES, for an Upwell structure: the volume of what the fit carries (fuel, ammunition). {0} is cubic metres. Structures' holds have no set size, so there is no limit after it.

data.name: DroneLine
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures: {0} the volume of drones in the drone bay, {1} its capacity; {2} the drone bandwidth the launched drones use, {3} the ship's. Four spaces separate the parts in English.

data.name: FighterLine
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures: {0} the volume of fighters in the fighter bay, {1} its capacity; {2} squadrons in launch tubes, {3} the tubes the ship has. Four spaces separate the parts in English.

data.name: FighterSlotsLight
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures, after the fighter bay: the light fighter launch slots. {0} in use, {1} how many the ship has.

data.name: FighterSlotsSupport
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures, after the fighter bay: the support fighter launch slots. {0} in use, {1} how many the ship has.

data.name: FighterSlotsHeavy
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures, after the fighter bay: the heavy fighter launch slots. {0} in use, {1} how many the ship has.

data.name: ValueHeading
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures: heading of what the fit is worth on the market. Upper case in English.

data.name: ValueHull
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: what the hull (the ship itself) is worth. {0} is an amount of ISK, such as 12.5M.

data.name: ValueModules
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: what the fitted modules are worth. {0} is an amount of ISK, such as 12.5M.

data.name: ValueDrones
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: what the drones and fighters are worth. {0} is an amount of ISK, such as 12.5M.

data.name: ValueCargo
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: what the cargo is worth. {0} is an amount of ISK, such as 12.5M.

data.name: ValueImplants
data.value: Implants and boosters {0} (the pilot's, not in the total)
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: what the implants and boosters are worth, which belong to the pilot rather than the ship. {0} is an amount of ISK, such as 12.5M.

data.name: ValueNoPrices
data.value: No market prices yet — choose an asset value market in Settings → Market.
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: shown when there are no prices. "Settings → Market" names the place in the Settings window.

data.name: ValuePrices
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: which prices the value uses. {0} is the price type and the market, such as "Split, Jita".

data.name: ValuePricesUnpricedOne
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: which prices the value uses, when some items have none. {0} is the number of items with no price (this form: one), {1} the price type and the market, such as "Split, Jita".

data.name: ValuePricesUnpricedOther
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: which prices the value uses, when some items have none. {0} is the number of items with no price, {1} the price type and the market, such as "Split, Jita".

data.name: PriceBasisWithMarket
data.comment: Fitting tool, VALUE: the prices used. {0} is the price type (Buy, Sell or Split), {1} the market's name. A comma and a space in English.

data.name: OffenseHeading
data.comment: Fitting tool, figures: heading of the fit's damage. Upper case in English.

data.name: Dps0
